items.name: Warm Lantern
items.description: A pocket of light for the path ahead.

visualDesign.summary: Rounded brass lantern with warm amber glass glow.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One compact upright lantern with broad toy forms.

items.name: Daisy Posy
items.description: A small bunch of meadow brightness.

visualDesign.summary: Tiny posy of three white daisies tied with a coral ribbon.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: Three broad flowers and one compact ribbon.

items.name: Storybook
items.description: A favorite little story kept close.

visualDesign.summary: Small closed warm-walnut and cream storybook.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One plump closed book with broad cover planes.

items.name: Star Wand
items.description: A playful spark at your side.

visualDesign.summary: Warm-gold five-point star wand with a short lavender handle.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One broad star and short rounded handle.

items.name: Cozy Mug
items.description: Something warm for a quiet moment.

visualDesign.summary: Rounded caramel ceramic mug with a little visible steam.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: Plump cup, broad handle, and two simple steam curves.

items.name: Pennant
items.description: A tiny flag for the next adventure.

visualDesign.summary: Blank teal and coral adventure pennant on a short wooden pole.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One broad triangular flag and short rounded pole.

items.name: Tiny Umbrella
items.description: Ready for one very local rain cloud.

visualDesign.summary: Compact dusty-coral umbrella with a rounded warm-wood handle.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One plump canopy with broad scallops and a short curved handle.
constraints: No rain, droplets, or open gaps in the canopy

items.name: Watering Can
items.description: A little water for whatever grows next.

visualDesign.summary: Small sage watering can with a cream rose and broad curved handle.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: Rounded can body, short spout, and one thick handle.
constraints: Preserve handle opening and show no water

items.name: Magnifying Glass
items.description: For clues that are probably very small.

visualDesign.summary: Rounded warm-brass magnifying glass with a caramel handle.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One thick circular rim and short broad handle.
constraints: Keep the lens opening transparent with no scenery reflection

items.name: Berry Lollipop
items.description: A sweet reward kept close by.

visualDesign.summary: Large berry-pink spiral lollipop on a short cream stick.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One broad candy disc and a short rounded stick.
constraints: No wrapper, text, or tiny spiral detail

items.name: Paintbrush
items.description: A little color for the next good idea.

visualDesign.summary: Short warm-wood paintbrush with a rounded coral-painted tip.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One broad handle, simple ferrule, and plump brush tip.
constraints: No palette, drips, splatter, or loose bristles

items.name: Toy Sword
items.description: Bravery, with every edge made friendly.

visualDesign.summary: Short rounded silver-and-blue toy sword with a warm-gold guard.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: Broad blunt blade, compact guard, and rounded pommel.
constraints: Clearly a harmless toy with no sharp point

items.name: Little Guitar
items.description: One small instrument for a very sincere song.

visualDesign.summary: Tiny caramel toy guitar with a cream sound hole and coral strap peg.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: Rounded figure-eight body and short broad neck.
constraints: No strap, text, logo, or individual strings

items.name: Seashell
items.description: A quiet little piece of the shore.

visualDesign.summary: Plump fan-shaped coral seashell with broad cream ridges.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One rounded fan with five broad soft grooves.
constraints: No sand, pearl, water, or realistic microtexture

items.name: Potion Bottle
items.description: A tiny bottle of probably-good magic.

visualDesign.summary: Rounded lavender potion bottle with a warm cork and simple gold collar.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One plump bottle, short neck, and oversized stopper.
constraints: Opaque toy material only, with no glow, bubbles, label, or symbol

items.name: Snow Globe
items.description: A whole quiet winter in one small place.

visualDesign.summary: Rounded pale-blue toy snow globe with one cream tree shape on a walnut base.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: Broad globe dome and thick rounded base.
constraints: No realistic glass, loose particles, scenery detail, or text

items.name: Plush Bunny
items.description: A soft friend for the side of every adventure.

visualDesign.summary: Tiny seated cream plush bunny with caramel ears and a coral bow.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One compact seated toy silhouette with broad rounded ears.
constraints: No fur fibers, separate character pose, or detailed face

items.name: Picnic Basket
items.description: Everything needed for a very small afternoon.

visualDesign.summary: Compact caramel picnic basket with a cream-and-coral cloth peeking out.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: Rounded basket box, one broad handle, and simple folded cloth.
constraints: No woven microtexture, food, or open lid

items.name: Telescope
items.description: For spotting the next bright possibility.

visualDesign.summary: Short navy-and-gold toy telescope angled gently upward.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: One broad compact tube with two rounded bands.
constraints: No tripod, scenery reflection, text, or extended sections

items.name: Flower Balloon
items.description: A little celebration floating close by.

visualDesign.summary: Single flower-shaped butter-yellow balloon with a short coral ribbon.
visualDesign.shapeLanguage: Five broad balloon lobes and one simple curved ribbon.
constraints: One balloon only, with no text, bouquet, or floating confetti
